tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge with no border, frame, letterbox band or matte of any kind. The pouch stands roll-top creased down at the near left, owning the left third of the frame, while the bed of fresh grounds blooms in a glass brewer just past it: a gooseneck's laminar silver thread enters from the top-left edge, cut by it, and strikes the centre of the bed so the crust domes and splits into pale tan fissures, gas lifting it visibly while crema-coloured foam crawls up the glass wall and a dark ring of liquor climbs behind it. 85mm at f/2.8 at counter height, the thread and the near crust razor-sharp, steam whipping through the raking window light and smearing at its top. AMBLE reads in large clean capitals on the wrapped matte kraft label with a hand-stamped roast date crooked beneath it, one seam corner lifted.
